12A.4 Chastity is preserved by wisdom and discretion.

precepts.text: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous; the heart is made sound in wisdom by keeping the laws of the Most High.
precepts.point: Let those that fear Thee turn unto me, and those that have known Thy testimonies. Let my heart be sound in Thy statutes, that I be not ashamed, sound in the wisdom of this Bible among the nations.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.” “He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.”

The heart is made sound in wisdom by keeping the laws of the Most High. He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous, and he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly, so the servant is not ashamed among the nations but sound in the wisdom of this Bible.

note.label: America and the World Will Pay Reparations

precepts.why:
“To deliver thee from the way of the evil man”: the Lord’s plan is to deliver us from the way of the evil man, “from the man that speaketh froward things.” Froward and forward are two different words: froward, f-r-o-w-a-r-d, means rebellious; forward, f-o-r-w-a-r-d, means forward thinking.

“Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness; Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked”: they delight in the rebellion, the rebelliousness of the wicked; they love that thing. Look at Dwyane Wade: the court allowed his child a legal name change and recognized the transition from male to female. That’s a man-child, that’s a boy, he got a ding-a-ling. You can’t make this stuff up.

“Whose ways are crooked”: their ways are crooked, the ways of this world are crooked, “and they froward in their paths.”

note.label: Identifying Babylon The Great

precepts.why:
“But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth”: the wicked is Esau. “And the transgressors shall be rooted out of it”: the transgressors are you and me, if we decide to break the Commandments; you online in those funky donkey camps.

There it is again: the same judgment. The Israelite who breaks the Commandments gets his portion with the unbelievers.

moments.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: If thou seekest her as silver and searchest for her as for hid treasures: so it's what the hid treasure is. It's God's commandments, understanding of his words. That is the hid treasure.

note.label: The Hidden Treasure

points: My son, if thou receive my words and hide my commandments with thee, so that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom and apply thine heart to understanding.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: Verses 2 through 4 explain what that means: crying after knowledge, lifting up thy voice for understanding, and seeking her as silver and searching for her as for hid treasures.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: The reward of hiding the commandments with thee is in verse 5: then shalt thou understand the fear of the Most High and find the knowledge of God.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: For the Most High giveth wisdom; out of His mouth cometh knowledge and understanding. He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous and is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: He keepeth the paths of judgment and preserveth the way of His saints. The saints are the Israelites, as we read yesterday.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, judgment, and equity, yea every good path, when wisdom enters into thine heart and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul; discretion shall preserve thee and understanding shall keep thee.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: Understanding delivers thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh forward things. Forward means things that are against the Most High, things that go contrary to the commandments.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: These evil men leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness, who rejoice to do evil and delight in the forwardness of the wicked, whose ways are crooked and who are forward in their paths.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: Understanding also delivers thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words, which forsaketh the guide of her youth and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: Her house inclineth unto death and her paths unto the dead; none that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life. This goes for men as well, and it is vice versa, so it is something to meditate on.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men and keep the paths of the righteous. For the upright shall dwell in the land and the perfect shall remain in it.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it. The whole chapter is basically showing the benefits of keeping the wisdom of the Most High.

note.label: Proverbs 2: The Benefits of Keeping the Wisdom of the Lord

points: “If thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee”: receive the word, hear the call, hide his commandments with you. Open the door and let him in.

note.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: “So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding.” To incline your ear is to say, I need to hear that, and then you apply yourself to understanding.

note.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: “If thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding” is another precept of calling upon him. “If thou seekest her as silver”: seek and you shall find, knock and the door will open. “And searchest for her as for hid treasures.” Many of us have not gone to that extent. Seek it out does not just mean buy a Bible and follow along in class. The way you know you must eat and drink and don’t feel right without it, the way some need their coffee every day, that is how you look for this. It is the apple of your eye.

note.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: “Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord.” Then, after you have done all these things. You have not understood the fear of the Lord if you have not done them. “And find the knowledge of God.” Seek, then understand; from understanding comes fear, and knowledge follows after. Knowledge is not just knowing the precept. The fear of the Lord is the entry-level requirement for knowledge: if you fear God, you won’t do things contrary to what he says.

note.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: “For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.” The same as Matthew 7 and Revelation 3: insight into what you need to do to build that fire inside of you.
